title: 两块石头的午后
goal: 在两个物体上保持一致光向和明暗分组
scene: TWO rounded angular stones of unequal size on pale gray-green ground; larger at left behind, smaller at right front. Both have pale beige top-left lit planes and ochre right-side shadow planes, a SINGLE coherent muted warm-gray ground shadow extends to lower right. Few olive grass strokes, white background. Clear grounded contact, no stone textures or gradients. Sun from upper left. Five discrete marker hues.
decision: 自行选择大小比例；两块石头的暗面与投影方向一致
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D2 specialized control, ONE primary skill, sparse simple scene. Scene: TWO rounded angular stones of unequal size on pale gray-green ground; larger at left behind, smaller at right front.
